points_note: hands keep every stored point (2048 = 1024 per hand); object, table and each distractor keep every second stored point (2048 -> 1024); 0 = every stored point
centring: mean of all points of the embodiment's own frame 0, no segment labels
voxel_note: no data-layer voxel reduction (voxel_size 0.0): every point is kept and predicted; the backbone sees one point per 5 mm voxel in every frame through the voxel_dedup wrapper and every point takes its voxel's features
